name: Reconstructive Ladder, Grafts and Free Flaps

reference.source: Plastic Surgery 5th Edition 2024 (topic map; text rewritten, no verbatim copy)
reference.pathophysiology: Grafted dermis imbibes inosculating revascularising while flaps rotate perfused transposing; anastomosed vessels thrombose congesting leeched, and expanded skin stretches recruiting extra cover.
additionalDifferentials: Graft versus flap by bed and movement
Local versus free by distance and vessels
STSG versus FTSG by contraction and site

figures.title: Reconstructive Ladder
figures.alt: Diagram illustrating the reconstructive ladder, showing direct closure, skin grafts (split-thickness and full-thickness), local flaps, regional flaps, and free flaps with microvascular anastomosis.
figures.caption: Hierarchy of reconstructive options from simple direct closure to complex free flaps. Illustration: StewardMD original.
